Decision recorded 2026-10-26 (user, in chat): option (1) — narrow the advisory Windows job to a maintained subset and hold that subset green. Long-path remedy: shorten the constructed paths; do not enable core.longpaths on the runner (a runner setting would hide the defect from CI while it stays live for downstream Windows users).

Correction to the 2026-10-25 triage comment: the class-1 fixture fix IS on main. tests/_topology_template.py:207 carries the gitdir-pointer guard (commits 04dd2d1e1de and 290424c8491, 2026-09-20); the work sat on other branches (investigate-6798, fix-icecold, fix-d724) and later landed. Nothing remains to land for class 1.

Fresh measurement. Scheduled run 40284466555, job 'sweep (windows)', ref 6080140e7af, created 2026-10-26 07:13Z, finished 09:14Z: '1652 failed, 18031 passed, 134 skipped, 1680 warnings, 39 errors in 7215.12s (2:00:15)'. Count basis: the first unindented 'short test summary info' block (nested subprocess summaries excluded); 1679 distinct node ids = 1652 FAILED + 27 ERROR, across 321 modules. Versus run 35511654149 (2026-09-20): errors fell from 1383 to 39 (class 1 cascade gone); failures stayed at about 1650.

By top-level directory (distinct ids): tests/unit 1008, tests/scripts 470 (53 modules), tests/interfaces 168, tests/integration 33. Summary-line signature counts (a row can match several): 474 rows in infra/server-script-shaped modules (observability, autodeploy, docker/journald/vartmp/container caps, user-data device resolution), 402 'Network access is forbidden' (network guard), 177 'Filename too long' (MAX_PATH), 112 UnicodeDecodeError, 48 fcntl/signal/geteuid/AF_UNIX, 11 PermissionError. Unverified: the per-signature counts only cover what the pytest summary line shows, and the 84 + 81 failures in tests/unit/test_review_bot.py and test_gate_step_tree_skew.py have not been root-caused. Nothing here was reproduced on Windows; it is CI-log analysis from macOS.
